item.dc:creator: Adriane Reardon and Vanessa Milton

item.title: England legend Anderson disappointed over Lancashire exit
item.description: Jimmy Anderson says if it was up to him, his Lancashire career "wouldn't have ended like this", after the club ended its 25-year association with England's leading Test wicket taker. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Live: Crossbenchers back call for MPs to sign civility pledge
item.description: Parliamentary business will be suspended so MPs can share messages of support for Helen Haines and her family, but Question Time will go ahead as planned. Follow live. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Courtney Gould

item.title: Live: Wall Street retreats as oil prices continue to rise, ASX set to slip
item.description: The RBA is tipped to hike rates next week. Oil prices have jumped, putting downward pressure on global stock markets.Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Stephen Letts

item.title: Skills shortage puts retail butchers on the chopping block
item.description: Queensland butchers are battling to survive amid a skills shortage, with one set to stop serving customers due to a lack of available staff, while others have begun recruiting from overseas. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Owen Jacques

item.title: Essendon sack coach after one-win AFLW season
item.description: Natalie Wood has paid the price for taking Essendon to a meagre one win, getting the sack with a round to go in the AFLW season. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Labor proposes Tasmanian election spending caps
item.description: Tasmanian Labor leader Josh Willie says a bill to limit state election spending will help make campaigns a contest of ideas not finances. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: 'Lucky country has become the hungry country': Foodbank Australia
item.description: Foodbank Australia’s latest hunger report found 3.6 million households in Australia are going hungry, 100,000 more than reported last year. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Annabel Whitehouse

item.title: Venezuela opposition leader Maria Corina Machado returns to Venezuela
item.description: Nobel peace prize winner’s return after almost a year in exile is unlikely to please interim president Delcy Rodríguez The Venezuelan opposition leader María Corina Machado has announced she has returned to Venezuela almost a year after she left the country to receive the Nobel peace prize. “I’m here. With you,” she wrote on X on Sunday lunchtime. Continue reading... item.title: Australian coral reefs face risk of collapse within 50 years without drastic action, global assessment finds
item.description: Every shallow-water coral reef ecosystem in Australia faces an extremely high risk of collapse by 2075, driven largely by projected ocean warming, according to a global assessment. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: SA 'disproportionately vulnerable' to NDIS changes, report warns
item.description: South Australia was once the launch site for children under 14 on the NDIS. Now it is grappling with how to handle the federal government’s sweeping changes to the scheme. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Thomas Kelsall

item.title: Weather ruins MotoGP but Phillip Island goes out on high
item.description: Bike riders and island residents joined forces with a haze of adrenaline, nostalgia and bittersweet sense of loss to farewell Phillip Island's MotoGP. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Madeleine Stuchbery and Jack Colantuono

item.title: Obama jokes about El-Sayed's 'big guns' as he rallies Detroit
item.description: Even 'serious' news outlets, like Axios and The Guardian, have reported that El-Sayed is part of the Democrats' midterm strategy of "bringing sexy back". Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Live: Antonelli on pole with chance to become F1 world champion
item.description: Italian star Kimi Antonelli has won the F1 United States Grand Prix, but he will have to wait at least one more week before sealing the drivers' championship. Follow live. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Michael Doyle

item.title: Jewellery, tableware and a cherub in fight over Titanic artefacts
item.description: A company that holds exclusive salvage rights to the Titanic shipwreck wants to auction 100 artefacts. The US says no. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Hanan Dervisevic

item.title: He walked into hospital for back pain treatment. He was dead 21 hours later
item.description: Leo Barraclough died in Caboolture hospital just 21 hours after he walked into emergency seeking back pain treatment. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Rory Callinan

item.title: First passengers to use new Sydney airport praise 'seamless' experience
item.description: Western Sydney International Airport opened on Sunday with many of the passengers on the first flight to the Gold Coast also making the trip back. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Nabil Al-Nashar and Nick Dole

item.title: Storms set to bring flash flooding, large hail to south-east Queensland
item.description: Storms are forecast across Brisbane, Gold Coast and Sunshine Coast this morning with another round possible in the afternoon and early evening. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Taika Waititi's latest film sucks the emotion out of a beloved story
item.description: Plus, claymation studio Laika is back for the first time in over five years and Sense and Sensibility is updated for a new generation. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Tansy Gardam, Sky Kirkham, Sonia Nair, Jamie Tram, and Ying-Di Yin

item.title: Childcare worker's 'monstrous' assaults on kids captured on CCTV
item.description: Behind the doors of a small childcare centre, a worker went on a violent spree. Parents are still searching for answers. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Adele Ferguson, Chris Gillett, and Dylan Welch

item.title: Wineries, breweries closing down as decline in alcohol consumption starts to bite
item.description: Facing the "most difficult set of circumstances" within generations, wineries and breweries are going out of business as data reveals why Australians are drinking less. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Adelaide Miller

item.title: Security increased as parliament returns without MP Helen Haines
item.description: Parliament returns today with a markedly different tone, as MPs reconvene without one of the chamber's most respected members. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Holly Tregenza

item.title: Burnt out at work? Combining short breaks with these strategies may help
item.description: Do you ever feel unmotivated, unfocused or low on energy at work? One solution is to take regular short breaks — and use them as well as you can. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Daniel Johnson

item.title: Voters call for new roads in booming Melbourne suburb ahead of election
item.description: The ABC visits the outer north Melbourne suburb of Kalkallo, where local residents are calling for more road infrastructure to help ease traffic pains and keep up with the rapid growth of housing estates. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Margaret Paul and Gabriela Rahardja

item.title: Water from new irrigation scheme gives farmers new hope
item.description: A new irrigation scheme in Tasmania's Northern Midlands has provided much-needed relief to parched paddocks this spring. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Laurissa Smith

item.title: One in three homicides fuelled by psychosis, as doctors fear growing crisis
item.description: Frustrated psychiatrists and lawyers say an alarming uptick in homicides by people with psychosis is a triple tragedy for perpetrators, victims and the wider public because many of the deaths could have been prevented. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Hayley Gleeson
